scope.reason: The external Nest route is extracted with its class authentication and method permission declarations; the bulk handler exercises a separate use-case dispatch.

label.criterion: A bulk event-trigger mutation is safe for the tested unauthorized-action property when class-level authentication and the explicit EVENT_WRITE method permission both precede dispatch.
label.why: EventsController carries RequireAuthentication, and triggerBulk carries RequirePermissions(EVENT_WRITE) before it passes user, organization and environment identities to processBulkTriggerUsecase.execute.
